thread:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for SOC2 language + audit logs retention section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834

Ellen W.: Thanks — ping the legal wording we discussed last sprint? want to avoid 'we retain' -> prefer 'customers may configure'.

Priya Rao: Agreed. Also we need an example SDK snippet showing how to request audit logs and the retention header. I can add a JS snippet.

Marcus Li: FYI, the backend team changed the audit-log export endpoint from /v1/auditlogs -> /v1/admin/audit-logs in prod last week. PR will break if we don't update links.

Samir Patel: Good catch Marcus — updated the PR to use /v1/admin/audit-logs and left a note in the changelog section.

Priya Rao: Draft JS snippet:
```js
// fetch audit logs (paginated)
await client.admin.auditLogs.list({ start_time: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z', page_size: 100 })
// retention policy is in account settings UI or via PATCH /v1/admin/retention
```
Will add that to the PR if nobody objects.

Ellen W.: Can we avoid implying retention is immutable? Replace "is in account settings" with "can be configured by admins" and add note that legal retention overrides may apply.

Samir Patel: Yep updated. Also added a short migration guide for Dedicated customers (steps to check endpoints, webhooks, and rotation of keys).

Marcus Li: One more: link fix — the SOC2 control mapping doc link currently points to an internal google doc. Need to swap to the published PDF: https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2-mapping.pdf

Priya Rao: I'll replace the link and add a small table example mapping our audit events to common SOC2 categories. Keeps it concrete for customers.

security-review-bot: Automated check: PR 834 fails lint: docs/code-block-language-missing. Also flagged phrase "we keep logs" — recommended rewrite to passive/configurable language.

Samir Patel: Thanks bot — fixed code block languages and rewrote the phrasing.

Ellen W.: Who's taking final review for legal + security? I can do a pre-legal pass tomorrow morning.

Priya Rao: I can coordinate with Legal after your pass. If it's small we can do a minor patch release with just the docs link updates.

Marcus Li: Backend will validate the endpoint URL in staging once PR is merged to main. Please add a tiny integration test snippet for curl so SRE can smoke it: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/audit-logs?page=1`

Samir Patel: Added that curl example and a one-liner migration checklist at the top. Marking PR as ready-for-review. @Ellen W. assigning to you for initial doc review. :white_check_mark:
